mgmt_bio.text: "Brad" Jacobs is founder, chairman and chief executive officer of QXO, Inc., having become chairman and CEO upon the June 6, 2024 closing of the equity investment, a $1 billion investment that took QXO into the building products distribution industry. He previously founded and led five public companies before QXO: United Waste Systems, United Rentals, XPO and XPO's spin-offs GXO Logistics and RXO, and he is managing partner of Jacobs Private Equity, LLC. Over his career, Jacobs and his teams have completed approximately 500 mergers and acquisitions and raised more than $60 billion in institutional capital. In December 2025 he announced he would step down from his chairman roles at XPO and GXO Logistics at year end to focus more on QXO.
